entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought a pair of your so-called 'performance' cycling shoes and they're complete garbage. I want my money back now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Are you serious? A 'preference issue'? These things gave me massive blisters after one ride! They're unusable! This isn't a preference, it's a defective product. I want a refund, not a twenty-questions game. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, and I assure you, you won't need a manager. I am authorized to handle this for you. I just need to ask a few standard questions. Were there any issues with the cleats or how they attached?

No, the cleats were fine! The shoes themselves are the problem. They feel like they're made of concrete. I'm telling you, if I don't get a full refund, I'm going to write a review on every cycling forum on the internet about how VeloFit sells torture devices instead of cycling shoes.
I hear you, and I appreciate you clarifying that. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
It's angry_customer@email.com. And it better be in the system.

Okay, one moment... I see it. You purchased the Pro-Pedal cycling shoes three weeks ago. I see that you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Well... why didn't you just say that from the start? Ninety days? Okay.

My apologies for any confusion. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Fine. As long as I get my money back. So I just print the label and send it? That's it?
That's correct. The email with the label and instructions should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
